dict.string: on alfred_script(q) set launching to not (application "Ghostty" is running) tell application "Ghostty" activate if launching then -- Launching opens a window of its own: type into it rather than -- adding a second tab next to it repeat 50 times try set t to focused terminal of selected tab of front window input text q to t send key "enter" to t return end try delay 0.1 end repeat end if set cfg to new surface configuration set initial input of cfg to q & linefeed if (count of windows) > 0 then new tab in front window with configuration cfg else new window with configuration cfg end if end tell end alfred_script
